After lunch, briefing for regular visitors
Please give it some attention
Travelers, read this first: the Companion Animal Travel Desk at Aurelia Skyways is here to help you prepare your pet for a calm trip and to keep the process smooth at the airport.

Our staff give patient attention to every animal and handle routine travel questions in a warm, professional way. Please bring any pet papers, carrier details, and care notes to the desk before you head to check-in. If your plan changes, tell us early so we can guide you through the next step without fuss. We also help with the everyday details that matter, from fitting the carrier to making sure your animal is comfortable and ready for the journey.

If you are traveling with a nervous pet, let the team know at once. A little advance notice helps us support you better and reduces stress for everyone involved. Travelers such as Priya Meyer and Hana Larsen have used the desk for practical help, and pets like Ellie are always met with steady care.

Please stop by the Companion Animal Travel Desk for support before you travel.
